title: Nolie Leonardo
bio: Nolie Leonardo is a tattoo artist at DNA Tattoo in Portsmouth, creating custom tattoos tailored to each client's vision. Whether you're planning your first tattoo or adding to an existing collection, Nolie works one-on-one with clients to develop meaningful, personalized artwork in a clean, professional studio environment. Known by many in the Hampton Roads community for his creativity, attention to detail, and collaborative approach, he strives to create tattoos that clients are proud to wear for a lifetime.
jessNote: I've personally worked with Nolie several times to honor my brother, Javuad and my Right-Hand herself, Kate. He's tattooed my team and family and I cannot recommend him enough.

title: Frank Liekefet
bio: DJ Frank Liekefet is a local Hampton Roads DJ providing music and entertainment for weddings, graduation parties, family celebrations, community events, and special occasions. Known for his friendly personality, reliability, and love of bringing people together, Frank focuses on creating a fun and memorable experience for guests of all ages. A devoted family man with a passion for motorsports and his local community, he brings energy, professionalism, and a personal touch to every event.

title: Brandons Pest Services
tagline: Pest Control - Termite Protection - Crawl Space Solutions
bio: Founded by Brandon Hedgepeth, Brandon's Pest Services is a family-owned pest management company serving Hampton Roads with a commitment to honesty, quality, and personalized service. With more than a decade of industry experience, Brandon specializes in pest control, termite treatments, crawl space services, inspections, and preventative solutions designed to protect homes and businesses. Known for thorough work, dependable service, and treating every property as if it were his own, Brandon has built a trusted reputation among homeowners, real estate professionals, and property managers throughout the region.

title: Artisan Counseling
bio: Artisan Counseling is a Hampton Roads counseling practice dedicated to helping individuals, couples, families, and children navigate life's challenges with compassion and evidence-based care. With offices in Suffolk and Newport News, their experienced team offers personalized therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, relationship concerns, life transitions, addiction, and more. Through in-person and telehealth appointments, Artisan Counseling strives to match each client with the right therapist, creating a supportive space where healing, personal growth, and lasting change can begin.
serviceArea: Offices in Suffolk & Newport News, plus telehealth

title: Travelin' TOMS Coffee Truck
tagline: Mobile Coffee Catering for Every Celebration
bio: Travelin' Tom's Coffee is a locally owned, veteran-led mobile coffee truck serving Hampton Roads. Owned by Navy veteran George Bowman III and his family, they're passionate about bringing handcrafted coffee and specialty beverages directly to schools, businesses, neighborhoods, weddings, private events, and community gatherings. Their mission goes beyond great coffee, they're committed to building connections, supporting local nonprofits, and serving the community one cup at a time.
serviceArea: Hampton Roads — truck comes to you

title: Amir Electric, Inc.
bio: Amir Electric, Inc. was founded by Amir Ahangari, a longtime Hampton Roads electrician whose reputation has been built on decades of honesty, craftsmanship, and exceptional problem-solving. Known for his extensive knowledge of the trade, Amir has earned the trust of generations of local families, often serving parents and later their children as they purchase homes of their own. Beyond his work, Amir has spent years mentoring apprentices, supporting fellow tradesmen as they launched their own businesses, and generously sharing his knowledge with others. His commitment to doing things the right way has left a lasting impact not only on the homes he's wired, but on the people he's helped along the way, making Amir Electric a trusted name in Hampton Roads for generations.
jessNote: I can personally vouch for him, he's my Dad! I wouldn't be who I am today in life and in business if it wasn't for him.

title: Babcock, Moore & Lambert, PLC
tagline: Civil Litigation - Personal Injury - Estate Planning - Insurance Defense - Employment Law
bio: Babcock Moore & Lambert, PLC is a women-led law firm serving Hampton Roads and Southeastern Virginia with a commitment to practical legal solutions, compassionate client service, and experienced advocacy. Founded on the belief that clients deserve attorneys they can trust and communicate with, the firm provides representation in personal injury, civil litigation, estate planning, insurance matters, employment law, and corporate law. With decades of combined litigation experience and a reputation for professionalism and integrity, the attorneys at Babcock Moore & Lambert are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal matters with confidence.
jessNote: Personally, Tina Babcock is my former boss, my attorney and always my first call when life happens. Period.

title: Jasmine Young Real Estate
tagline: Realtor & Associate Broker With Iron Valley
bio: Jasmine Young is a REALTOR® and Associate Broker with The Foundry Group at Iron Valley Real Estate Hampton Roads, bringing more than a decade of experience to buyers and sellers across the 757. She began her real estate career in new-home sales before becoming a licensed agent and later earning her broker's license, giving her a well-rounded understanding of everything from new construction to resale transactions. Jasmine is especially passionate about guiding first-time homebuyers, taking the time to explain each step, answer questions, and help clients move forward with confidence. A longtime Hampton Roads resident and active Portsmouth community leader, she combines local knowledge, professional experience, and genuine care to build relationships that last well beyond the closing table.

title: The Suburban Farm Lady
tagline: Homestead Living for the Modern Family
bio: Founded by Sarah Leland, Suburban Farm brings a touch of homestead living to Hampton Roads through handcrafted teas, natural wellness products, farm-fresh eggs, plants, candles, and educational workshops. With a passion for sustainable living and community connection, Sarah helps others explore natural remedies, herbal traditions, and simple ways to incorporate a more intentional lifestyle into everyday life. You can find many of her products and classes at Lazy Daisy in Virginia Beach.
jessNote: I can proudly say Sarah has been on our books for over a year, her and Kate have bonded so much I lost custody (haha). But I've had the pleasure of attending vendor events with Sarah and personally trying her teas and 10/10.
serviceArea: Products & classes at Lazy Daisy, Virginia Beach

title: Rey Tanning
tagline: Awarded Best of Virginia Beach - Custom Spray Tans
bio: Founded by Riley and built as a women-owned business, Rey Collective is a luxury sunless tanning and beauty studio serving Hampton Roads with locations in Hilltop and the Virginia Beach/Chesapeake area. Specializing in custom spray tans, bridal tanning experiences, and teeth whitening services, Rey Collective focuses on helping clients feel confident while prioritizing skin health and avoiding UV damage. Known for its personalized approach, attention to detail, and elevated client experience, Rey Collective has become a go-to destination for a natural, year-round glow.
serviceArea: 1616 Hilltop West Shopping Center, Virginia Beach

title: C&C Carpet
bio: C&C Carpet Care was founded by Scott Capps Sr. in 1992 with a commitment to providing honest, dependable service to families throughout Hampton Roads. As a locally owned and family-operated business, C&C has built its reputation on quality workmanship, integrity, and treating every home with the same care and respect they would their own. With more than 40 years of industry experience, Scott and his team specialize in carpet cleaning, repairs, stretching, upholstery, tile, and restoration services, helping homeowners protect and restore the spaces they love.

title: The DogFather's Dog Walking, LLC
tagline: Professional Local Dog Walker / Care Taker
bio: Founded by Joshua Parker, The Dog Father's Dog Walking LLC provides dependable and personalized pet care services for busy pet owners throughout Hampton Roads. Built on a genuine love for animals, the business focuses on giving dogs the exercise, attention, and companionship they need while providing peace of mind for their families. Whether it's daily walks, pet visits, or individualized care, The Dog Father's Dog Walking LLC is dedicated to treating every pet like family.
jessNote: I've had 1st hand experience with Josh, and 10/10 I do recommend!
serviceArea: Hampton Roads — comes to your home

title: Beach Accounting Services
bio: Beach Accounting Services was founded by Stacey Gossett, a Virginia Beach native whose passion for helping businesses thrive has made her a trusted resource throughout Hampton Roads. With a bachelor's degree in accounting and years of experience serving a diverse client base, Stacey provides personalized bookkeeping, payroll, tax support, and financial services with accuracy, integrity, and care. Through Beach Accounting Services, she is committed to building lasting relationships and giving business owners the confidence and peace of mind to focus on what they do best.
jessNote: Stacey, has handled my business and personal taxes since I started Bless This Mess. She works with me, and has always kept the anxiety out of tax season for me.

title: Passionately Living
tagline: Trauma Therapy - Couples Counseling - Relationship Healing
bio: Founded by Rebecca Jones, LPC, NCC, Passionately Living is a Virginia Beach-based wellness and therapy practice focused on relational and personal healing. The practice offers trauma therapy, couples counseling, premarital counseling, relationship consultation, EMDR, EFT, intensives, and nature-based and equine-assisted therapy options. Rebecca is an EMDR Certified Therapist and Consultant, and she uniquely offers EquiLateral Equine-Assisted EMDR, blending trauma-focused care with the healing environment of the farm. With services available in office, virtually, at the beach, and on the farm in Pungo, Passionately Living creates a compassionate space for clients to heal, reconnect, and grow.
jessNote: I can proudly say Rebecca is my personal client, and I swear I just go there to clean...but somehow I always leave with my brain scratched and my perspective adjusted. If that's what happens in her kitchen, I can only imagine what happens in her office.
serviceArea: Virginia Beach — office, virtual, beach & the farm in Pungo

title: SOLidify Learning
bio: SOLidify Learning was founded by local educator Morgan Dietz, whose passion for helping children succeed has led her to invest back into the community she proudly calls home. Serving students from preschool through 12th grade, SOLidify Learning provides personalized academic support through licensed educators who focus on building confidence, strengthening foundational skills, and helping every child reach their full potential.

title: Crafted Style Co.
bio: Crafted Style Co. was founded by Meghan Hall, a local Hampton Roads artist whose passion for hand-painted signs and modern calligraphy brings life's most meaningful moments to life. From weddings and birthdays to classrooms and special celebrations, Meghan creates custom pieces that are thoughtfully designed and handcrafted with timeless detail. Every creation is made with heart, helping families, teachers, and businesses celebrate milestones in a beautifully personal way.

title: My Vegan Sweet Tooth
bio: My Vegan Sweet Tooth is Virginia's first 100% vegan bakery, located on Virginia Beach Boulevard and known for its made-in-house desserts, custom cakes, donuts, cupcakes, cinnamon rolls, cookies, brownies, muffins, and allergy-friendly options like gluten-free, nut-free, and soy-free treats. Founded by the Deveau family, the bakery opened in 2010 with a mission rooted in compassion for animals while still creating desserts that everyone can enjoy. Beyond the storefront, the family has supported local animal charities including the Virginia Beach SPCA, donated customer tips to animal-focused causes, and fostered kittens through the years — a beautiful reflection of the heart behind the business.
jessNote: As someone who has personally cleaned for them, I can say this is one of those local businesses where the values go far beyond the baked goods.

title: Marathon Moving Services
bio: Marathon Moving Services is a locally owned Hampton Roads moving company founded by Milton Whitaker a Virginia Beach native, who has built a reputation for treating every move with professionalism, integrity, and care. Proud to serve the community he calls home, Milton and his team help families and businesses navigate one of life's biggest transitions with dependable service and clear communication. From local and long-distance moves to packing and specialty items, Marathon Moving Services is committed to making every move as smooth and stress-free as possible.

title: Sunless Skin By Jen
tagline: Custom Spray Tans - Healthy Sunless Glow
bio: Sunless Skin by Jen was created with a simple goal: helping clients achieve a beautiful, confidence-boosting glow without the damaging effects of UV exposure. Jen specializes in customized spray tans designed to complement each client's natural skin tone, whether you're preparing for a wedding, vacation, special event, photoshoot, or simply want to feel your best. By taking a personalized approach to every appointment, she focuses on delivering natural-looking, streak-free results in a welcoming and comfortable environment, so every client leaves feeling radiant, confident, and ready to shine.

title: Scarlet Hair Co.
bio: Scarlet Hair Co. is owned by Virginia Beach native Ciara Strong, a graduate of Ocean Lakes High School and a BELLAMI Master Certified extension artist. Specializing in luxury blonding, custom color, and premium hair extensions, Ciara is passionate about creating personalized transformations that leave every client feeling confident, beautiful, and empowered. Whether you're looking for a subtle refresh or a complete hair makeover, you'll find expert care and artistry in her chair.

title: The Sweet Spot
bio: The Sweet Spot is owned by Mery Ghattas, a Hampton Roads entrepreneur whose journey reflects the diversity and determination that make our community so special. Originally from Beirut, Lebanon, Mery earned her degree from Old Dominion University before turning her passion for desserts into one of the area's most recognizable sweet shops. Today, The Sweet Spot is known for its over-the-top milkshakes, funnel cakes, ice cream, churros, coffee, and handcrafted treats that bring families and friends together. More than a dessert shop, Mery has created a place where the Hampton Roads community celebrates life's sweetest moments. Whether she's serving up something sweet or simply making someone's day a little brighter, that's who Mery is at her core.
jessNote: Personally, I grew up with Mery, she has been someone I have looked up to and had deep respect for since high school. I admire her hustle, her resilience, and her strength.

title: Chris Hedger - National Roofing Corp.
tagline: Professional Sales Manager - National Roofing Corp.
bio: For more than 50 years, National Roofing Corporation has been serving Hampton Roads with residential, commercial, and industrial roofing solutions. As a family-owned company based in Suffolk, they've built a reputation for quality workmanship, long-term relationships, and standing behind their work. Whether you're replacing an aging roof, planning a new construction project, or need repairs after storm damage, their experienced team can help guide you through the process.

title: VA Maid in the Shade
tagline: Professional Residential Cleaning Co. Serving Norfolk, VA
bio: VA Maid in the Shade is a locally owned, family-owned cleaning and home management company serving families throughout Hampton Roads. Originally founded by Ashley Allen's mother and later passed down to Ashley, the business has grown through generations of dedication, personalized service, and a commitment to helping clients create clean, comfortable, and well-managed homes. Known for its natural cleaning approach and dependable care, Maid in the Shade offers everything from routine maintenance cleaning to household support services while building lasting relationships throughout the community.

title: Hang It Up Wreaths by Amy
bio: Hang It Up Wreaths was founded by Portsmouth native Amy McMullin, whose creativity and resilience shine through every handcrafted piece she creates. A graduate of Tallwood High School and Assistant Director at Churchland Christian Academy, Amy designs custom wreaths, keychains, and seasonal décor with heart and purpose. Every purchase not only supports a local small business but also helps Amy continue her courageous fight against ovarian cancer while doing what she loves, bringing joy, beauty, and a personal touch to homes throughout Hampton Roads.

title: Covenant United Methodist - DAYCARE
tagline: K3-K4 Full-Time & Part-Time Daycare Provider - Before/After Care - Summer Camps
bio: Covenant Child Care provides a safe, nurturing, Christ-centered environment where children are encouraged to learn, grow, and thrive. Located in the Western Branch community of Chesapeake, their experienced team offers preschool, childcare, and before- and after-school programs that blend hands-on learning with creativity, social development, and Christian values. With engaging activities including art, music, science, Bible stories, and play-based learning, Covenant partners with families to help every child build confidence, character, and a lifelong love of learning.
jessNote: I have had the absolute pleasure of sending my children here, they were referred to me by a best friend of mine named Paige Stone. Paige always sent to me the BEST places, and alot of this directory reminds me of her. Unfortunately I lost Paige before she could see The Village Collective launch, and witness her own favorites displayed proudly across Hampton Roads. If you visit Covenant Daycare, tell them Paige Stone sent you. She had a gift for finding the best people, and I hope this directory continues that legacy.

title: The Lash Cove VB
tagline: Custom Lash Extensions - Master Esthetician - Beauty Studio
bio: The Lash Cove is a Virginia Beach lash studio founded by certified lash artist and Master Esthetician Dani Shauger. Dani began her business with a love for lashes and a passion for helping women feel confident, beautiful, and completely themselves. Known for creating customized sets that complement each client's natural features, from soft and effortless to full and dramatic—she brings both technical skill and thoughtful attention to every appointment. What started as one woman's small business has continued to grow into a talented studio team and even Dani's own coastal-inspired professional lash line, Lash Noted. Located inside The Studio 120 in Red Mill Commons, The Lash Cove offers a welcoming, elevated beauty experience built with care, creativity, and intention.
serviceArea: The Studio 120, Red Mill Commons, Virginia Beach

title: Cooke Veterinary
tagline: Whole-Pet Veterinary Care Where Modern Medicine Meets Holistic Healing
bio: Founded by Dr. Denette Cooke, Cooke Veterinary Medical Center has been serving pets and their families in Chesapeake since 2002. Known as “The Place for Healing,” the practice combines advanced veterinary medicine with integrative treatment options, including acupuncture, nutrition, herbal therapies, and Traditional Chinese Veterinary Medicine. With a strong focus on prevention, individualized care, and the human-animal bond, Cooke Veterinary Medical Center offers a compassionate approach that treats each pet as a whole, helping them live healthier and more comfortable lives.

title: AirForce Mechanical & Solar
tagline: Licensed Technicians Providing Quality Services for HVAC Systems Heating Cooling Electrical Gas & Solar
bio: Airforce Mechanical & Solar is a family-owned, veteran-owned company serving Hampton Roads with HVAC, electrical, natural gas, and solar energy solutions. With more than 25 years of experience, their team is committed to honest service, quality workmanship, and helping homeowners improve the comfort, safety, and efficiency of their homes. From heating and cooling repairs to solar installations and electrical upgrades, Airforce Mechanical & Solar provides reliable solutions backed by a strong reputation for customer care and integrity.

title: Allured By Ashley
bio:
Allured Artistry was founded by Ashley Garraway, a professionally trained makeup artist whose passion for timeless beauty has made her one of Hampton Roads' most sought-after bridal artists. After receiving advanced training at the Make-up Designory (MUD) in New York City, Ashley brought her expertise to Virginia, where she has spent years helping brides feel confident, radiant, and authentically themselves on one of life's most meaningful days. Through Allured Artistry, she has built a luxury bridal beauty brand rooted in professionalism, artistry, and genuine care, creating personalized experiences that leave every client feeling beautiful long after the final brush stroke.

 • VA / Destinations

title: Key Glass Repair, LLC
bio: Founded by Keyonna, Key Glass Repair LLC is a Black-owned, woman-owned auto glass company proudly serving Hampton Roads from its Virginia Beach location. Specializing in windshield replacement, auto glass repair, and calibration services, the company is known for its commitment to quality workmanship, exceptional customer service, and strong community engagement. Through both its business and social media presence, Key Glass Repair actively supports local initiatives, small businesses, and community connections while helping drivers get back on the road safely and confidently.

title: Jess Nicole Photography
bio: Jess Nicole Photography is a Hampton Roads photography business dedicated to capturing life's most meaningful moments through timeless and authentic imagery. Specializing in creating a relaxed and personalized experience, Jess works closely with families, couples, children, and individuals to preserve memories that can be cherished for years to come. Her approach focuses on genuine connections, natural emotion, and beautifully documented milestones.

title: The Velvet Current
bio: The Velvet Current is a boutique skincare and beauty studio in Norfolk's Ghent neighborhood, founded by licensed esthetician Jessie Bartlett. With over seven years of experience in esthetics and nine years as a lash artist, Jessie offers a personalized experience that blends advanced skincare with a holistic approach to self-care. As a rising Reiki practitioner, she believes beauty and wellness go hand in hand, creating a peaceful space where clients can relax, recharge, and leave feeling confident inside and out.

title: Sparkle Klean Wash Pro
tagline: Pressure Washing - Soft Washing - Exterior Cleaning
bio: Founded by Chesapeake native Jason Middleton, Sparkle Klean Wash Pro is a family-owned pressure washing and exterior cleaning company serving communities throughout Hampton Roads. A graduate of Western Branch High School, Jason brings years of leadership experience from Newport News Shipbuilding and Norfolk Naval Shipyard, along with a passion for helping homeowners protect and maintain their properties. Specializing in pressure washing, soft washing, roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, concrete cleaning, fence restoration, and exterior home care, Sparkle Klean Wash Pro has built its reputation on quality workmanship, exceptional customer service, and a commitment to treating every home as if it were their own. As a Black-owned local business, Jason and his team take pride in serving the community while helping homes and businesses look their very best.

title: Simply Southern Bakery, LLC
tagline: Homemade Sourdough Breads - Cookies - Sweet Treats
bio: Simply Southern Bakery, LLC is a locally owned home bakery founded by Tonia Wagoner, whose passion for baking began in the family kitchen and has grown into a love for sharing homemade treats with her community. Specializing in handcrafted sourdough breads, soft cinnamon rolls, fresh-baked cookies, and other small-batch favorites, every recipe is made with care, quality ingredients, and a touch of Southern hospitality. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply craving something homemade, Simply Southern Bakery brings comforting, made-from-scratch goodness from her kitchen to your table.

title: Bless This Mess Cleaning
bio: Life gets messy, that's where we come in. At Bless This Mess Cleaning, we believe a clean home creates room to breathe, reconnect, and enjoy what matters most. Whether you need routine maintenance, a deep clean, or help preparing for a move, we treat every home with the same care we'd give our own. No judgment, no shortcuts, just dependable service from people who genuinely love helping others.

title: The Branches Of Birth, LLC
bio: The Branches of Birth LLC was founded by Asyia Jackson, a Hampton Roads birth professional whose own motherhood journey inspired a passion for supporting families through pregnancy, birth, and the postpartum season. As a Virginia state-certified full-spectrum doula with a background in psychology, Asyia provides compassionate, evidence-based care while empowering parents through education, advocacy, and personalized support. Her mission is simple: to ensure every family feels seen, heard, and confidently supported as they welcome new life.
jessNote: Asyia came to Bless This Mess a little over a year ago. She smacked Kate and I so hard with kindness, love and gratitude and ALL the pregnant mommies we officially named a whole cleaning package after her! The Asyia Nest!

title: Tidewater Rent & Haul
bio: Tidewater Rent & Haul is a family-owned, veteran-owned business proudly serving the Hampton Roads community with dependable dumpster rentals, hauling, and debris removal services. Built on integrity, hard work, and a commitment to helping neighbors tackle projects big and small, their team is dedicated to providing honest communication, reliable service, and a hassle-free experience from start to finish. Whether you're renovating, moving, or cleaning out a property, Tidewater Rent & Haul is committed to helping keep our local communities clean, one project at a time.
serviceArea: Hampton Roads — delivered to your site

title: Travel By Natalie Kroll
bio: Founded by Natalie Kroll, Travel by Natalie Kroll is a Hampton Roads travel advisory business specializing in cruises, luxury vacations, honeymoons, and custom travel experiences. Since 2016, Natalie has helped travelers plan stress-free adventures by combining her personal travel experience with extensive industry training and certifications. As a CLIA Certified Cruise Counsellor, she is passionate about matching clients with the perfect itinerary, whether they're planning a romantic getaway, family vacation, river cruise, or once-in-a-lifetime journey. Known for her personalized service and attention to detail, Natalie works closely with each client to turn travel dreams into unforgettable experiences.
serviceArea: Hampton Roads & remote — plans travel anywhere

title: Elegance By Emily
tagline: Private Hair Salon, Low-Maintenance Color, Bridal Styling
bio: Elegance by Emily is a private salon suite in Chesapeake owned by licensed cosmetologist Emily Thomas, whose passion is helping women rediscover their confidence through personalized hair care. A graduate of Rudy & Kelly Academy and stylist with over seven years of experience, Emily specializes in creating a relaxing, one-on-one experience for busy women and moms. From effortless color transformations to bridal styling, every appointment is designed to leave you feeling refreshed, confident, and beautifully yourself.
